findings.description: run() method CCN 29 exceeds threshold of 15. The method is 130+ lines with nested if/else, switch statements, and async calls. High complexity makes testing difficult and increases bug risk.
findings.remediation: Extract methods: private func processVADState(_ state: VadState, chunk: [Float]) -> VADAction; private func handleSpeechStart(); private func handleSpeechEnd(); private func processPartialTranscription(). Reduces run() to ~30 lines with 5 extracted helpers.

findings.description: transcribeFile() method CCN 26 exceeds threshold. 100+ line method with validation, upload, polling, and error handling all intertwined. Nested do-catch and multiple phase handling.
findings.remediation: Split into phase methods: private func uploadPhase(audioData: Data, apiKey: String) async throws -> URL; private func createTranscriptPhase(uploadURL: URL, ...) async throws -> String; private func pollPhase(transcriptID: String, ...) async throws -> Result. Each < 30 lines.

findings.description: mergeStreams() method CCN 22 exceeds threshold. Complex async stream handling with multiple nested loops, error handling, and buffer management. 95+ lines.
findings.remediation: Extract stream filling logic: private func fillBuffer(from iterator: AsyncIterator, into buffer: inout [Float], count: Int) async -> Int; Extract mixing: private func mixAndWrite(micBuffer: [Float], sysBuffer: [Float], micCount: Int, sysCount: Int).

findings.description: Magic numbers in bit depth conversion: case 16, 24, 32 with no named constants. Comment explains but no semantic naming: Int16.max used inline.
findings.remediation: Define enum: enum BitDepth: Int { case pcm16 = 16; case pcm24 = 24; case pcm32 = 32; var maxValue: Float { switch self { case .pcm16: return Float(Int16.max); ... } } }

findings.description: Multiple nonisolated let properties (12+) create clutter at top of actor. All immutable configuration properties are marked nonisolated but could be grouped.
findings.remediation: Group into configuration struct: struct TranscriptionConfig: Sendable { let backend: any TranscriptionBackend; let locale: Locale; ... }. Then: nonisolated let config: TranscriptionConfig. Reduces 12 properties to 1.

findings.description: HTTP status code switch is 40+ lines with magic numbers (200..<300, 401, 403, 429, 500..<600). Hard to extend and no semantic naming.
findings.remediation: Create HTTPStatus enum: enum HTTPStatusCategory { case success; case unauthorized; case rateLimited; case serverError }. Add init(statusCode: Int) for categorization.

findings.description: DEBUG build uses mock factory - surprising behavior. #if DEBUG factory = MockServiceFactory() is unexpected and could lead to 'works on my machine' bugs in production.
findings.remediation: Add explicit mode for mock usage: case .live(useMockInDebug: Bool). Or use separate .development mode. Document the behavior in comments and README.

findings.description: Hardcoded size estimate in getTotalSize(): return 1_200_000_000 // ~1.2GB. No explanation of source or fallback mechanism.
findings.remediation: Add struct ModelSizeEstimate with documentation: struct ModelSizeEstimate { static let glmASR4Bit: Int64 = 1_200_000_000 // Based on mlx-community/GLM-ASR-Nano-2512-4bit config.json }. Or fetch from HuggingFace API.

findings.description: Memory budget documentation in block comment instead of searchable/swift-doc format. Good content but not easily discoverable.
findings.remediation: Convert to proper documentation comments with /// and add to README: /// Memory Budget (from TASK-016 design): ... | Component | Before | After |.
